Subject: Trial access & light-touch setup timeline for Brightboard

Hi Claire —

Really enjoyed the conversation earlier — thanks for carving out time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from today
- Brightboard use case: real-time summarization + policy-aware redaction of conversation transcripts for your support teams.
- Priority metrics: <5s response at 95th pct, cost target <$0.0009/token after caching.
- Success criteria for a 2-week trial: 1) end-to-end demo ingesting 1k real transcripts, 2) redaction rules validated on 5 representative prompts, 3) <5s median latency for 512-token responses during a light-workload window.

Next steps (proposed timing)
1) I’ll provision a trial sandbox for Brightboard by end of day tomorrow (credentials attached).
2) Monica will share a 10-minute setup checklist and a short script to validate redaction rules.
3) We schedule a quick 20-min async screen-share on Wed/Thu next week to walk through the initial ingest if you’d like.

Attachments: trial-setup-checklist.pdf (setup checklist), redwood-quickstart-credentials.txt (temp API key and endpoints).

If priorities have shifted, tell me — we can pause the trial provisioning or move to a later date. Otherwise I’ll go ahead with provisioning tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sean
